title: Missing EPIPE handling
detail: The original code handled an OSError with errno.EPIPE by silencing flush errors and exiting with code 1. The new code only re-raises the exception when errno != EPIPE, leaving EPIPE unhandled. This causes a crash with a traceback when the output pipe closes early. The same applies to line 1609.

title: Potential IndexError on empty ignored_nodes
detail: The code assumes `ignored_nodes` is non‑empty and accesses its last element. If a comment is processed with no ignored nodes, this will raise an IndexError and crash the formatter.

title: Incorrect EOF detection in _get_endmarker_and_dedents
detail: When a non-DEDENT leaf is found before the ENDMARKER, the function incorrectly returns that leaf and the collected dedents, causing the caller to treat the node as if it were at EOF. The intended behavior is to return None and an empty list to signal that the node is not at the end of the file.
note: Describes the planted flip: a leaf before the end marker is returned as one.

title: Incorrect logical operator for non-interactive check
detail: The condition uses `or` instead of `and`, causing a blank line to be printed even when the console is interactive but not Jupyter, which defeats the purpose of the `disable` flag.

title: Incorrect lock check and missing await
detail: The code checks a non‑existent attribute `locked` instead of calling the `locked()` method on the Twisted lock. It then calls `self._export_lock.acquire()` without awaiting it, so the lock may not be held before the item is exported, leading to race conditions.
note: Its second half is the planted missing await, but it's four lines off, and its first half is wrong: `locked` is an attribute of DeferredLock.

title: Incorrect accept_html logic
detail: The property should return `True` when `text/html` is accepted, but the code returns `True` when it is *not* present, causing `accept_html` to always be `False` for valid headers.
